name: Skardu
description: The gateway to Baltistan: cold desert, glacial lakes like Upper Kachura and Shangrila, and the high Deosai plains by jeep.
lead: Cold desert, glacial lakes and the high Deosai plains, two days north of Lahore

image.alt: Still water of Upper Kachura Lake at dawn, reflecting a sunlit rocky peak and tall poplars

overview.headline: Cold desert and glacial lakes at the end of the Indus road
paragraphs: Skardu sits in a wide bowl of the Indus, ringed by bare mountains: sand dunes on the valley floor, poplar villages along the river, and clear lakes tucked into the hills at Kachura.

It is also the way up to Deosai, one of the highest plateaus on earth, where the road crosses open grassland and wildflowers in summer. Up the Shigar valley, a restored fort marks the old route towards K2.

seasons.text: Apricot blossom in April, though Deosai is still under snow. Days 12–20°C.
Warm and dry, 25–32°C in the valley. The road over Deosai opens from late June.
Gold poplars and clear skies in October. Days 10–20°C, nights near freezing.
Very cold, down to −15°C at night. Deosai and the high roads close.

places.name: Upper Kachura Lake
places.text: A deep, clear lake in the hills above Skardu, with rowing boats in summer.

image.alt: Upper Kachura Lake from above, a deep blue pool ringed by green trees below bare, rocky mountains

places.name: Shangrila
places.text: Lower Kachura Lake and its gardens, the easy lakeside stop on the way in.

image.alt: Lower Kachura Lake mirrors a steep mountain and autumn trees, with a red pagoda roof and small cottages on the far shore.

places.name: Cold desert
places.text: Sand dunes under snowy peaks at Katpana, best at sunset.

image.alt: Rippled golden sand dunes of the Katpana desert lead to bare poplars and a hazy grey mountain range under a clear sky.

places.name: Shigar Fort
places.text: A restored 17th-century palace of the Amacha rulers, on the old road towards K2.

image.alt: Stone and timber walls and wooden stairs in the courtyard of Shigar Fort

places.name: Deosai Plains
places.text: One of the highest plateaus on earth: open grassland, streams and wildflowers in summer.

image.alt: A clear stream winding through the green grassland of the Deosai plains, under a line of snowy peaks

places.name: Sheosar Lake
places.text: A high, still lake at the western edge of Deosai.

image.alt: Still water of Sheosar Lake reflects snow-streaked rounded peaks above green alpine grass on the Deosai plateau.
